name: burst_source
description: Paced image source for the overflow:block test. Starts IDLE; exchange 'start' resets its counters and begins emitting one trigger every period_ms on a DEDICATED thread (a back-pressure-tolerant source — the intended safe target for overflow:block). exchange 'stop' halts + joins the emit thread. get_def reports 'emitted'.

outputs.name: img
outputs.doc: 16x16 gray, first 8 bytes = uint64 LE seq
